title: Passkeys, command palette and board views
changes: Sign in with a passkey; a setup wizard follows your first password sign-in.
Command palette and unified keyboard shortcuts.
Board list view, and subscriptions that follow what you have access to.
Descriptions and comments render as Markdown.
Project and milestone progress is derived from their issues.
Change priority straight from rows and cards; reorder projects in the sidebar.
New issues start in the column you created them from.
Manage team and organisation labels and team states from the teams page.
Unified assignee picker with regional date and time formats.
Smaller images with a lightbox viewer.
The desktop client is retired: everything runs in the browser.

title: Inbox, notifications and activity
changes: Inbox with notifications and an activity feed.
Boards use one column per state.
Archived issues are read-only.

title: AI assistant access over MCP
changes: Connect AI assistants over MCP, authorised with your own account via OAuth.
Assistants can read and create issues, and edit issues, projects, documents and issue files.
Assistants can read, post and edit comments.
The project picker offers the projects of the issue's own team.
Fixed a title rendering issue.

title: Issues linked to project documents
changes: Link issues to project documents.

title: Project overview and archive navigation
changes: Toggle a project's overview.
Navigate to and from the archive.
